description: Data-driven gotcha detection rules. Add new rules here — gotcha-detector.sh reads this file dynamically.

rules.message: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated — returns naive datetime causing timezone bugs. Use datetime.now(timezone.utc) instead.
.cast(String) on enum/status columns kills PostgreSQL indexes. Filter on the native enum type instead.
HouseholdMember uses is_primary_contact, not is_primary. The shorter name silently matches nothing in SQLAlchemy filters.
overflow:hidden on flex/grid containers clips child scroll areas. Use overflow:clip + min-height:0 instead.
Security hook blocks innerHTML. Use DOM API (createElement, textContent, append) instead.
scalar_one_or_none() crashes with MultipleResultsFound on non-unique columns. Verify filter is on a unique column, or use scalars().first().
